scenario: Alterion 面试里，面试官顺着寒暄问：「So, how was working on TikTok?」你想借这句自然切进技术话题。
scenario_en: In the Alterion interview the interviewer segues, "So, how was working on TikTok?" You want to ride it smoothly into technical talk.
q: 怎么从这句寒暄自然过渡到讲你的技术工作？
q_en: How do you bridge from this into your technical work naturally?
options: Honestly it was a great run — mostly ads and campaign backend. Happy to dig into any of it.
How was working on TikTok... yeah, I feel that feels good, we do some production logic, how how to promote the campaign campaigns...

Oh it was really good, I mean there were ups and downs like any job, some great teammates, some tough sprints, I learned so much about myself and about scale and collaboration, honestly I could go on and on...
My tenure at TikTok was satisfactory. I performed backend responsibilities pertaining to advertising campaigns.
tradeoff: 定调后主动递话 vs 复读加卡壳：一句定调加邀请显得从容可控；复读问题再结巴，把跳板浪费成空转。
why: 寒暄式的开放问题是切技术的跳板：一句「挺好的，主要做广告/campaign 后端」定调，再抛「随便挑一块深聊」把主动权递给对方。复读问题加卡壳只会显得没准备好。
why_en: A casual "how was it?" is a springboard — give a one-line warm take ("great run, mostly ads and campaign backend"), then offer to go deeper on any of it.
whenOtherWins: 只有当面试官只想闲聊、还没进技术环节时，才用一句轻松感受带过，不急着切进技术细节。
options_en: Honestly it was a great run — mostly ads and campaign backend. Happy to dig into any of it.
How was working on TikTok... yeah, I feel that feels good, we do some production logic, how how to promote the campaign campaigns...

Oh it was really good, I mean there were ups and downs like any job, some great teammates, some tough sprints, I learned so much about myself and about scale and collaboration, honestly I could go on and on...
My tenure at TikTok was satisfactory. I performed backend responsibilities pertaining to advertising campaigns.
optionMeanings: 一句暖感受定调，再邀请对方挑一块深聊。
复述问题、结巴「how how、campaign campaigns」卡在原地。
泛泛感慨「有起有落、学到很多」，不落到技术。
用「My tenure was satisfactory」的公文腔总结。
optionMeanings_en: One warm take to set the tone, then invites them to pick a thread.
Repeats the question and stutters "how how, campaign campaigns," stuck.
Vague feelings — "ups and downs, learned a lot" — never reaching tech.
Sums up in a stiff "my tenure was satisfactory" register.
optionScenarioImpacts: 顺势切进技术，主动权还留在你手里。
显得没准备好，跳板被浪费成空转。
情绪铺一大堆，对方等不到任何技术信号。
生硬像述职报告，聊不下去。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Slides into tech while you keep control of the thread.
Reads as unprepared; the springboard spins in place.
Lots of feeling, no technical signal for them to grab.
Stiff like a status report — the chat can't continue.
optionDirectness: 抓住「定调 + 递话」，一步从寒暄进技术。
错在原地打转，复读加结巴没有推进。
错在方向，答成感受总结而非技术切入。
错在语域，口语切技术却用书面公文体。
optionDirectness_en: Nails "set tone, then hand off" — one step from chat into tech.
Wrong — spinning in place; echo plus stutter makes no progress.
Wrong direction — a feelings recap instead of a technical entry.
Wrong register — entering tech out loud in written bureaucratese.
